reponses.libelle: If "Yes" is selected: Please provide a brief overview of your trade sanctions policies/procedures and controls.
reponses.valeur: Group policy applies to all controlled entities, branches and joint ventures. Screen customers, beneficial owners, directors, employees, suppliers, end-users, intermediaries and transactions at onboarding, daily and before payment/shipment against the scenario versions of Poland, EU, UN, UK and OFAC lists. Compliance investigates alerts; transactions are held pending clearance. Quarterly risk review, annual independent audit (last 2026-06-30), annual staff training, escalation and incident records are maintained.
